## Overview

Each ROI contains co-located immune (CD45⁺) and tumour (PSMA⁺, PanCK⁺PSMA⁻) AOIs, which allows three exploratory questions. (1) Coupling: does an immune programme in an ROI track the tumour programme of the same ROI, and does that coupling differ with response? This is fitted as the standardised immune score ~ tumour score × PSA change + batch + (1 | patient). (2) Ligand–receptor co-expression: for 24 curated pairs (OmniPath was not available), the ROI score is the mean of the ligand z-score in the sending AOI and the receptor z-score in the receiving AOI. It is modelled as LR ~ PSA change + batch + (1 | patient), with non-responder versus responder in baseline strata. (3) Heterogeneity: for patients with at least three ROIs in a stratum, the s.d. across ROIs of key programmes and of the tumour fraction is related to outcome at patient level (Spearman with PSA change; Wilcoxon, non-responder versus responder).

Scores come from comp_05 (singscore on RUV-4 data), z-scored expression from comp_02, and tumour fraction from comp_03b. These AOI-level analyses are not calibrated by patient-level permutation and are hypothesis-generating.

**Manuscript items supported**

- Supplementary Fig. 4b–d (ligand–receptor co-expression and within-ROI tumour–immune coupling; drawn by comp_11)
- Supplementary Table 12 (ligand–receptor co-expression versus outcome), written to the workbook by comp_11
- Exploratory analyses; not calibrated by patient-level permutation

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --only 07_crosstalk`. Approximate runtime: minutes.

**Inputs**

- `results/C2_normalization/normalized_strata.qs`
- `results/C5_signatures/per_AOI_singscores.qs`
- `results/C3_deconvolution/deconvolution_proportions.qs`

**Outputs**

- `results/C7_crosstalk/within_roi_coupling.csv`
- `results/C7_crosstalk/ligand_receptor_associations.csv`
- `results/C7_crosstalk/roi_heterogeneity_associations.csv`

**Depends on**: `comp_02_normalize`, `comp_03b_deconv`, `comp_05_signatures`

## Analysis

Script header: the three crosstalk and heterogeneity analyses and their models.

Sources the shared set-up and reads the normalised strata, the per-AOI scores and the epithelial-tumour fractions. Defines small helpers for coefficient extraction, error-tolerant lmer fitting and ROI keys (patient × ROI name).

```{r comp-07-crosstalk-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE comprehensive analysis -- C7: compartment crosstalk and ROI heterogeneity
##  (1) Within-ROI coupling: does the immune (CD45+) programme in an ROI track the
##      co-located tumour (PSMA+ / PanCK+PSMA-) programme, and does that coupling
##      differ with response?  ROI-level mixed model:
##        immune_score ~ tumour_score * outcome + study_batch + (1|patient)
##  (2) Ligand-receptor co-expression across co-located AOIs (curated pairs; OmniPath
##      not installed): LR score per ROI = mean(z ligand in sender AOI, z receptor in
##      receiver AOI); LR ~ outcome + study_batch + (1|patient)
##  (3) Intra-sample heterogeneity: SD across ROIs (patients with >= 3 ROIs) of key
##      programmes, tested against outcome at patient level.
## Outcome = continuous PSA change (capped, per 50%); NR vs R in baseline strata.
## Uses C2 (RUV-4 logCPM) and C5 (per-AOI singscores).
## ============================================================================

source(file.path(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."), ".build", "comp_00_guard.R"))
suppressMessages({ library(qs); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(lmerTest); library(ggplot2) })
setwd(PRINCE_DIR)
check_ram_or_stop(20)

norm <- qs::qread(out_path("C2_normalization", "normalized_strata.qs"), nthreads = 1)
sc <- qs::qread(out_path("C5_signatures", "per_AOI_singscores.qs"))
dec <- qs::qread(out_path("C3_deconvolution", "deconvolution_proportions.qs"))
tum_frac <- c(dec$lineage_primary[, "Epithelial_tumour"], dec$lineage_bone[, "Epithelial_tumour"])
seg_code <- c("CD45+" = "CD45", "PSMA+" = "PSMA", "PanCK+PSMA-" = "PanCKPSMA")

co <- function(f, term) {
  if (is.null(f)) return(c(NA, NA, NA))
  s <- summary(f)$coefficients
  if (term %in% rownames(s)) s[term, c("Estimate", "Std. Error", "Pr(>|t|)")] else c(NA, NA, NA)
}
safe_lmer <- function(form, d) tryCatch(suppressMessages(lmer(form, data = d)), error = function(e) NULL)
roi_key <- function(df) paste(df$subject_id, df$roi_name)

```

### Within-ROI coupling
For each timepoint and tumour compartment, matches each CD45⁺ AOI to the tumour AOI of the same ROI. It then fits every pair of tumour programme (IFN-I/STING, HLA-I, MHC-I, IFN-γ, NEPC-up, AR panel, FOLH1, CD276) and immune programme (cytotoxic, CD8 effector, exhaustion, Treg, M2, bone TAM/TIM, DC activation, T-cell-inflamed) with standardised scores:
- y ~ x + study_batch + (1 | patient), for overall coupling;
- y ~ x × psa + study_batch + (1 | patient), for coupling that differs with PSA response.

BH-FDR is applied within timepoint × tumour compartment.

```{r comp-07-crosstalk-02}
## ---- (1) within-ROI coupling -----------------------------------------------------
tumour_progs <- c("paper_CAN26|IFN_I_STING_tumour", "paper_CAN26|HLA_I", "immune|MHC_I",
                  "immune|IFNG_6gene_Ayers", "immune|IFN_I", "lineage|NEPC_up", "lineage|AR_panel",
                  "gene|FOLH1", "gene|CD276")
immune_progs <- c("immune|Cytotoxic_effector", "immune|CD8_effector", "immune|T_exhaustion",
                  "immune|Treg", "immune|M2_macrophage", "paper_CAN26|Bone_TAM_TIM",
                  "paper_CAN26|DC_activation", "immune|Tcell_inflamed_GEP")
coup <- list()
for (tp in c("Archival", "Screening", "Cycle1")) for (tseg in c("PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA-")) {
  imm <- sc[[paste0("CD45__", tp)]]; tum <- sc[[paste0(seg_code[tseg], "__", tp)]]
  imm$key <- roi_key(imm); tum$key <- roi_key(tum)
  keys <- intersect(imm$key, tum$key)
  im <- imm[match(keys, imm$key), ]; tu <- tum[match(keys, tum$key), ]
  base <- im[, c("subject_id", "response_group_neat", "psa_change_capped", "study_batch")] %>%
    mutate(psa = psa_change_capped / 50)
  for (tpg in intersect(tumour_progs, colnames(tu))) for (ipg in intersect(immune_progs, colnames(im))) {
    d <- base %>% mutate(x = as.numeric(scale(tu[[tpg]])), y = as.numeric(scale(im[[ipg]])))
    f0 <- safe_lmer(y ~ x + study_batch + (1 | subject_id), d)
    f1 <- safe_lmer(y ~ x * psa + study_batch + (1 | subject_id), d)
    a <- co(f0, "x"); b <- co(f1, "x:psa")
    coup[[paste(tp, tseg, tpg, ipg)]] <- data.frame(
      timepoint = tp, tumour_segment = tseg, tumour_prog = tpg, immune_prog = ipg, n_roi = nrow(d),
      coupling = a[1], p_coupling = a[3], interaction_psa = b[1], p_interaction = b[3])
  }
}
coup <- bind_rows(coup) %>% group_by(timepoint, tumour_segment) %>%
  mutate(fdr_coupling = p.adjust(p_coupling, "BH"), fdr_interaction = p.adjust(p_interaction, "BH")) %>% ungroup()

```

### Ligand–receptor co-expression
Defines 24 curated ligand–receptor pairs with a direction (tumour→immune, immune→immune, immune→tumour). For each co-located ROI, the score is the mean of the ligand z-score (RUV-adjusted expression) in the sending AOI and the receptor z-score in the receiving AOI. It is fitted as score ~ psa + study_batch + (1 | patient). In Archival and Screening it is also fitted as score ~ NR + study_batch + (1 | patient), excluding intermediate patients. BH-FDR is applied within timepoint × tumour compartment.

```{r comp-07-crosstalk-03}
## ---- (2) ligand-receptor pairs across co-located compartments ------------------------
lr_pairs <- tribble(
  ~ligand,   ~receptor,   ~direction,
  "CD274",   "PDCD1",     "tumour->immune",
  "PDCD1LG2","PDCD1",     "tumour->immune",
  "HLA-E",   "KLRC1",     "tumour->immune",
  "LGALS9",  "HAVCR2",    "tumour->immune",
  "PVR",     "TIGIT",     "tumour->immune",
  "NECTIN2", "TIGIT",     "tumour->immune",
  "CD47",    "SIRPA",     "tumour->immune",
  "MIF",     "CD74",      "tumour->immune",
  "SPP1",    "CD44",      "tumour->immune",
  "TGFB1",   "TGFBR2",    "tumour->immune",
  "CSF1",    "CSF1R",     "tumour->immune",
  "CXCL12",  "CXCR4",     "tumour->immune",
  "TNFSF11", "TNFRSF11A", "tumour->immune",
  "GDF15",   "GFRAL",     "tumour->immune",
  "CXCL9",   "CXCR3",     "immune->immune",
  "CXCL10",  "CXCR3",     "immune->immune",
  "CCL19",   "CCR7",      "immune->immune",
  "CCL21",   "CCR7",      "immune->immune",
  "IFNG",    "IFNGR1",    "immune->tumour",
  "TNF",     "TNFRSF1A",  "immune->tumour",
  "GAS6",    "AXL",       "immune->tumour",
  "GAS6",    "MERTK",     "immune->immune",
  "TGFB1",   "TGFBR2",    "immune->tumour",
  "IL6",     "IL6R",      "immune->tumour")
lr_res <- list()
for (tp in c("Archival", "Screening", "Cycle1")) for (tseg in c("PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA-")) {
  ni <- norm[[paste0("CD45__", tp)]]; nt <- norm[[paste0(seg_code[tseg], "__", tp)]]
  ki <- roi_key(ni$cd); kt <- roi_key(nt$cd); keys <- intersect(ki, kt)
  Zi <- scale(ni$Yadj)[match(keys, ki), , drop = FALSE]
  Zt <- scale(nt$Yadj)[match(keys, kt), , drop = FALSE]
  base <- ni$cd[match(keys, ki), c("subject_id", "response_group_neat", "psa_change_capped", "study_batch")] %>%
    mutate(psa = psa_change_capped / 50)
  for (r in seq_len(nrow(lr_pairs))) {
    lp <- lr_pairs[r, ]
    snd <- if (startsWith(lp$direction, "tumour")) Zt else Zi
    rcv <- if (endsWith(lp$direction, "tumour")) Zt else Zi
    if (!(lp$ligand %in% colnames(snd) && lp$receptor %in% colnames(rcv))) next
    d <- base %>% mutate(y = (snd[, lp$ligand] + rcv[, lp$receptor]) / 2)
    a <- co(safe_lmer(y ~ psa + study_batch + (1 | subject_id), d), "psa")
    dn <- d %>% filter(response_group_neat %in% c("Responder", "Non_Responder")) %>%
      mutate(NR = as.integer(response_group_neat == "Non_Responder"))
    b <- if (tp != "Cycle1") co(safe_lmer(y ~ NR + study_batch + (1 | subject_id), dn), "NR") else c(NA, NA, NA)
    lr_res[[paste(tp, tseg, r)]] <- data.frame(
      timepoint = tp, tumour_segment = tseg, ligand = lp$ligand, receptor = lp$receptor,
      direction = lp$direction, n_roi = nrow(d), beta_psa = a[1], p_psa = a[3], beta_NR = b[1], p_NR = b[3])
  }
}
lr_res <- bind_rows(lr_res) %>% group_by(timepoint, tumour_segment) %>%
  mutate(fdr_psa = p.adjust(p_psa, "BH"), fdr_NR = p.adjust(p_NR, "BH")) %>% ungroup()

```

### ROI heterogeneity
For each stratum, takes patients with at least three ROIs and computes the s.d. across ROIs of FOLH1, NEPC-up, AR panel, T-cell-inflamed, MHC-I, IFN-I/STING and tumour fraction. Strata with at least eight such patients are tested by Spearman correlation with capped PSA change and by a Wilcoxon test of non-responders versus responders, with BH-FDR within stratum.

```{r comp-07-crosstalk-04}
## ---- (3) intra-sample heterogeneity (SD across ROIs) ------------------------------
het_feats <- c("gene|FOLH1", "lineage|NEPC_up", "lineage|AR_panel", "immune|Tcell_inflamed_GEP",
               "immune|MHC_I", "paper_CAN26|IFN_I_STING_tumour", "tumour_fraction")
het <- list()
for (sid in names(sc)) {
  s <- sc[[sid]]; s$tumour_fraction <- tum_frac[rownames(s)]
  ph <- s %>% group_by(subject_id, response_group_neat, psa_change_capped) %>%
    filter(n() >= 3) %>%
    summarise(across(any_of(het_feats), ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), n_roi = n(), .groups = "drop")
  if (nrow(ph) < 8) next
  for (f in intersect(het_feats, colnames(ph))) {
    sp <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(ph[[f]], ph$psa_change_capped, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
    g <- ph$response_group_neat
    w <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(ph[[f]][g == "Non_Responder"], ph[[f]][g == "Responder"], exact = FALSE)$p.value,
                  error = function(e) NA)
    het[[paste(sid, f)]] <- data.frame(stratum = sid, feature = f, n_patients = nrow(ph),
      n_NR = sum(g == "Non_Responder"), rho_psa = unname(sp$estimate), p_psa = sp$p.value,
      median_sd_R = median(ph[[f]][g == "Responder"]), median_sd_NR = median(ph[[f]][g == "Non_Responder"]),
      p_NR_vs_R = w)
  }
}
het <- bind_rows(het) %>% group_by(stratum) %>% mutate(fdr_psa = p.adjust(p_psa, "BH")) %>% ungroup()

```

### Report and save
Prints the nominally significant results of each analysis and writes the coupling, ligand–receptor and heterogeneity tables.

```{r comp-07-crosstalk-05}
## ---- report + save ----------------------------------------------------------------
options(width = 220)
fmt <- function(x) as.data.frame(x %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~signif(.x, 3))))
cat("\n==== (1) Coupling that differs with PSA response (p_interaction < 0.05) ====\n")
print(fmt(coup %>% filter(p_interaction < 0.05) %>% arrange(p_interaction)), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n==== (1b) Strongest overall tumour-immune coupling (FDR < 0.05), top 15 ====\n")
print(fmt(head(coup %>% filter(fdr_coupling < 0.05) %>% arrange(p_coupling), 15)), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n==== (2) Ligand-receptor associations (p < 0.05 either outcome) ====\n")
print(fmt(lr_res %>% filter(p_psa < 0.05 | p_NR < 0.05) %>% arrange(pmin(p_psa, p_NR, na.rm = TRUE))), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n==== (3) ROI heterogeneity associations (p < 0.05) ====\n")
print(fmt(het %>% filter(p_psa < 0.05 | p_NR_vs_R < 0.05) %>% arrange(p_psa)), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(coup, out_path("C7_crosstalk", "within_roi_coupling.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(lr_res, out_path("C7_crosstalk", "ligand_receptor_associations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(het, out_path("C7_crosstalk", "roi_heterogeneity_associations.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nC7 complete.\n")
```
